payload.voice: Narrative: Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta visits Rav
payload.summary: Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta takes leave of Rav, and his father tells him to go back for a blessing; Rav blesses him that he should not shame nor be shamed, but Rabbi Shimon dismisses it as mere words.

payload.title: Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta's blessing from Rav
payload.summary: Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta is sent by his father to receive a blessing from Rav. Rav blesses him that he should not cause shame nor be shamed. When Rabbi Shimon returns, his father interprets this as a blessing equivalent to the one God gave Israel in the verse 'And My people shall never be ashamed.'
